Dear Voat, what are some things from your childhood that are gone now?

Here's Jamie oliver's take
Blockbuster. And not being able to use the internet while my mom was on the phone

The show Are You Afraid of the Dark? is no longer around. As well as the Goosebumps show. While they were no where near as awesome as shows like the Twilight Zone they were pretty good for children's television.
Try Darknet on Netflix, it's a similar type of show to those sort of things but a bit more intelligently designed.
I will have to check it out then. I am a huge fan of shows those I listed. I still watch a lot of The Twilight Zone even though I have seen pretty much every episode multiple times.

Saturday morning cartoons.

Yes many of them were just glorified toy comercials but I still fondly remember spending hours each saturday morning watching them.
I used to wake up so early that I would have to wait through the infomercials
You can still watch cartoons, you just need to go to the kids channels.

Food: Arch burger came and went, came again and went again.Josta I can't describe it really, it was sort of similar to a Dr Pepper, but it's own thing and taste and pulled from the market. Crystal Clear Pepsi was pretty neat and I loved it. 3D Doritos, the last ones I had were in 99' or 00'. The loss and return of the enchirito on the taco bell menu.

Sort of unique stuff: Novelty cups. I've got a Hardee's cup with the Ghostbusters II logo on it and at one point I had one for pretty much every Batman. All the films that had any remote kid appeal also had a linked cereal which was basically some variation of another cereal that was already out just with relevant shapes. I do miss the hell out of novelty cups, though no idea why.

Video stores were great, CD stores are slowly becoming a thing of the past, cassettes though especially were a great thing. When you took the time to actually make a mix tape it took hours to get it right and make sure you didn't record over something and to get the playlist just right because no one wants to sit through rewinding or fast forwarding through shit. CDs made it a bit easier since it was all drag and drop or pick from a file folder and rip, but if you had an older CD player you'd have to drop the burn speed (DVDs had a similar problem for a few years.)

Kinder Eggs in the US... I remember, although I wish I didn't because it was glorious.

Encyclopedias. I used to love picking a volume and just reading random stuff in it. It was all so fascinating.

There's stupid shit like pogs, but it's no different than something like Neo pets. Just a cash in now fad in which more will come and go.

The Berlin wall. That was still a thing in my childhood. One of my earliest memories is sitting in my mother's lap watching on television while it was torn down. I didn't know what to think or feel, but I knew what ever it was it was important.

There's a lot of stuff. Some good, some bad. I wish classic Tom and Jerry was still made, I mean sure it was a bit violent, but all in all you didn't have kids trying to do that shit to one another.
food... remember 49 cent wednesdays? and yes, the 3d doritos!

25 cent gumball machines (they were called that even if they dispensed toys). Yeah you still see something sometimes but they're not the same thing at all.
